classes.name: RWGltf_CafReader
classes.summary: The glTF (GL Transmission Format) mesh reader into XDE document.

instanceMethods.name: ToParallel
instanceMethods.comment: Return TRUE if multithreaded optimizations are allowed; FALSE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetParallel
instanceMethods.comment: Setup multithreaded execution.

instanceMethods.name: ToSkipEmptyNodes
instanceMethods.comment: Return TRUE if Nodes without Geometry should be ignored, TRUE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetSkipEmptyNodes
instanceMethods.comment: Set flag to ignore nodes without Geometry.

instanceMethods.name: ToLoadAllScenes
instanceMethods.comment: Return TRUE if all scenes in the document should be loaded, FALSE by default which means only main (default) scene will be loaded.

instanceMethods.name: ToApplyScale
instanceMethods.comment: Return TRUE if non-uniform scaling should be applied directly to the triangulation. FALSE if the average scale should be applied to the transformation matrix.

instanceMethods.name: SetLoadAllScenes
instanceMethods.comment: Set flag to flag to load all scenes in the document, FALSE by default which means only main (default) scene will be loaded.

instanceMethods.name: ToUseMeshNameAsFallback
instanceMethods.comment: Set flag to use Mesh name in case if Node name is empty, TRUE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetMeshNameAsFallback
instanceMethods.comment: Set flag to use Mesh name in case if Node name is empty.

instanceMethods.name: IsDoublePrecision
instanceMethods.comment: Return flag to fill in triangulation using double or single precision; FALSE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetDoublePrecision
instanceMethods.comment: Set flag to fill in triangulation using double or single precision.

instanceMethods.name: ToSkipLateDataLoading
instanceMethods.comment: Returns TRUE if data loading should be skipped and can be performed later; FALSE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetToSkipLateDataLoading
instanceMethods.comment: Sets flag to skip data loading.

instanceMethods.name: SetToApplyScale
instanceMethods.comment: Set flag to apply non-uniform scaling directly to the triangulation (modify nodes). TRUE by default. In case of FALSE the average scale is applied to the transformation matrix.

instanceMethods.name: ToKeepLateData
instanceMethods.comment: Returns TRUE if data should be loaded into itself without its transferring to new structure. It allows to keep information about deferred storage to load/unload this data later. TRUE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetToKeepLateData
instanceMethods.comment: Sets flag to keep information about deferred storage to load/unload data later.

instanceMethods.name: ToPrintDebugMessages
instanceMethods.comment: Returns TRUE if additional debug information should be print; FALSE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetToPrintDebugMessages
instanceMethods.comment: Sets flag to print debug information.

instanceMethods.name: ToEmbedTexturesInGlb
instanceMethods.comment: Return flag to write image textures into GLB file (binary gltf export); TRUE by default. When set to FALSE, texture images will be written as separate files. Has no effect on writing into non-binary format.

instanceMethods.name: SetToEmbedTexturesInGlb
instanceMethods.comment: Set flag to write image textures into GLB file (binary gltf export).

instanceMethods.name: ToMergeFaces
instanceMethods.comment: Return flag to merge faces within a single part; FALSE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetMergeFaces
instanceMethods.comment: Set flag to merge faces within a single part. May reduce JSON size thanks to smaller number of primitive arrays.

instanceMethods.name: ToSplitIndices16
instanceMethods.comment: Return flag to prefer keeping 16-bit indexes while merging face; FALSE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetSplitIndices16
instanceMethods.comment: Set flag to prefer keeping 16-bit indexes while merging face. Has effect only with `ToMergeFaces()` option turned ON. May reduce binary data size thanks to smaller triangle indexes.
